meta.regulationBasis: FIA 2026 Formula 1 Technical Regulations — Section C Issue 21 (2026-10-19) & Section B Sporting Issue 09

aeroConceptSummary.frontNoseAndWing: Slender high-mounted two-stage crash nose (RV-NOSE) terminating cleanly on the fixed central saddle (|Y| <= 150 mm) of element 2 via canted twin-keel swan pylons (RV-FW-PYLON), leaving an unbroken full-span spoon mainplane and leading slot gap beneath the nose tip; outboard movable flaps fw_flap_2 and fw_flap_3 (|Y| in [155, 668 mm]) on dual-link cambered slot-gap pivots; curved footplate venturi tunnels (RV-FWEP-OFP/IFP).
aeroConceptSummary.wheelWakeControl: Legal 1-element triangular in-washing floor boards (RV-FLOOR-BOARD, XF in [650, 1350 mm], |Y| in [710, 890 mm]) and internal drum shrouds only; strictly zero over-wheel winglets.
aeroConceptSummary.sidepodsAndFloor: High-waisted crescent sidepod inlet tucked beneath the upper SIS spar (Z_FIA in [400, 550 mm]) feeding a deep twin-channel longitudinal top canyon onto the diffuser roof, paired with an aggressive swept floor undercut (RV-SIDEPOD + RV-FLOOR-BODY).
aeroConceptSummary.engineCoverAndRoll: Shrink-wrapped MGU-H-free 1.6L 90-deg V6 spine (RV-EC) with stepped dorsal cooling plenum, parametric cooling gills (settings 1..5), 20g elliptical principal roll hoop (RV-ROLL-HOOP, structure at [XC=55, 0, 968]), and Grade-5 Ti-6Al-4V FIA8869-2018 Halo.
aeroConceptSummary.rearWingAndTail: Beam-wingless twin-pylon (RV-RW-PYLON, |Y| in [50, 110 mm]) 3-element rear wing (RV-RW-PROFILES, Z_FIA in [725, 880 mm]) + lower crash-structure brace (RV-RW-BRACE, Z_FIA in [310, 350 mm]). Dual-link cambered slot-gap pivots on fw_flap_2, fw_flap_3, rw_flap_2, rw_flap_3 that flatten cleanly in Straight Mode without detaching from hinge pins (NOT a rotating Macarena wing).

cleanRoomIpGuardrails: Zero copied geometry, meshes, UV layouts, textures, LUTs, or aero/torque curves from RSS Formula Hybrid, VRC Formula Alpha, DeX 2026 Prototype (vf26 / f12026 / ported cars), or any real 2026 F1 team.
All aerodynamics, kinematics, tyre thermals, powertrain maps, CAD meshes, and audio graphs must be derived clean-room from first-principles physics and FIA 2026 Section C Issue 21 equations.

solverAndGltfSpace.description: LibreCorsa Three.js / glTF 2.0 (.glb) / VehiclePhysics / SimCarRig canonical coordinate frame.

axes.x: +X = Left (driver port side); -X = Right (driver starboard side)
axes.y: +Y = Up (vertical normal to flat road plane); y = 0.0 is static flat ground contact plane
axes.z: +Z = Forward (toward front wing / nose); -Z = Rearward (toward diffuser / tailpipe)

origin.definition: Ground-projected static Dry+Driver Centre of Gravity: x = 0 on vehicle symmetry plane, y = 0 at static tyre ground tangent plane, z = 0 at longitudinal static CoG (front axle z = +1.836 m, rear axle z = -1.564 m).

rotationsRightHandRule.aboutX_PitchAndWheelSpin: +rotation.x pitches nose DOWN (+Y moves toward +Z forward). Forward wheel rolling (wheelRotationRad > 0) is +rotation.x. Flattening inverted active-aero flaps around rear-quarter (72-75% chord) dual-link pins in Straight Mode is NEGATIVE rotation.x.
rotationsRightHandRule.aboutY_YawAndRoadSteer: +rotation.y yaws nose LEFT (+Z moves toward +X). Note CarTelemetry.steering in [-1, +1] uses +1 = steer RIGHT, so roadWheelSteerRad = -steering * maxRoadWheelSteerRad.
rotationsRightHandRule.aboutZ_RollAndSteeringColumn: +rotation.z rolls top (+Y) toward driver RIGHT (-X). With steering_wheel local +Z pointing forward into the column, clockwise right-hand steering (steering > 0) is +rotation.z = +steering * maxSteeringWheelLockRad.

blenderAuthoringSpace.description: Blender 4.x native Z-up scene space prior to bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(export_yup=True).

axes.z: +Z_bl = Up (+Y_gltf); Z_bl = 0.0 is static ground plane

fiaSectionCSpace.description: FIA 2026 Section C Article C2.1.1 Car Coordinate System.

axes.X_FIA: +X_FIA = Rearward (XF = 0 at front axle plane, XR = 0 at rear axle plane)
axes.Y_FIA: +Y_FIA = Driver Right (-X_gltf); Y_FIA = 0 on symmetry plane
axes.Z_FIA: +Z_FIA = Upward from Car Reference Plane (Z_FIA = 0 is bottom of sprung floor / top of 10 mm plank; plank bottom is Z_FIA = -10 mm)

suspensionKinematicsCornerSpace.origin: [0, 0, 0] at the static wheel center of the respective corner

axes.x: +x = Inboard toward vehicle centreline (x_gltf = 0) for BOTH left and right corners

solverAndTelemetryUsedBy: CarTelemetry 4-corner arrays (wheelLoadsN, tireTempsC, brakeTempsC, suspensionTravelMm, etc.)

lc26Design.note: Two-stage crash nose terminates cleanly onto fixed central bridge (|Y| <= 150 mm) of element 2 via twin-keel swan pylons; unbroken full-span spoon mainplane & primary slot gap pass open underneath.

RV-CH-FRONT_AND_MID.minCrossSectionRV_CH_FRONT_MIN: Width 268..380..490 mm, height 300..415 mm from XA=0 to XC=-875

RV-SIDEPOD.lc26Design: High-waisted crescent inlet tucked beneath upper SIS spar (Z_FIA 380..535 mm), aggressive undercut sweeping inboard from |Y|=705 mm down to |Y|=385 mm at floor junction, feeding twin longitudinal dorsal canyons.

RV-EC.lc26Design: Shrink-wrapped MGU-H-free V6 engine cover with stepped dorsal cooling plenum + parametric cooling gill louvres (levels 1..5) within RV-BW-APERTURE (XF 1400..2600, |Y| 80..600, Z 375..700).

RV-ROLL-HOOP.loadRating: 20g elliptical abrasion-resistant principal roll hoop with 60x30 mm recovery strap aperture

RV-FWEP-OFP_AND_IFP.wheelClearanceCylinder: Trimmed by Ø925 mm cylinder at [XF=0, Z=360] for Y in [560, 900]
RV-FWEP-OFP_AND_IFP.lc26Design: Curved footplate venturi tunnels from |Y|=565 mm to |Y|=895 mm (total FW width = 1.790 m <= 1.800 m Issue 21 & <= 2.000 m brief ceiling) + single diveplane inside RV-FWEP-DIVEPLANE.

RV-FW-PYLON.lc26Design: Canted twin-keel swan pylons at |Y| in [68, 138 mm] landing onto the fixed central saddle of element 2.

RV-FW-SM-MID.lc26Design: Dual-link active-aero actuator & hinge pods at |Y| = 320 mm.

RV-RW.beamWingProhibition: STRICTLY ZERO beam wing elements permitted between Z_FIA = 350 mm and Z_FIA = 725 mm; only lower crash-structure brace inside RV-RW-BRACE (Z_FIA 310..350 mm) is allowed.

RV-RW-PYLON.lc26Design: Twin swan-neck/undermounted pylons at |Y| = 82 mm leaving centreline exhaust plume unobstructed.

RV-FLOOR-BOARD.lc26Design: Legal 1-element triangular in-washing wheel-wake control board behind front wheel (>= 15 deg inward tangent rearward of XF=825), connected via floor board stays in RV-FLOOR-BRACE.

RV-SIS.enclosureRule: Fully enclosed by sidepod/floor bodywork; upper spar forms structural brow directly above crescent sidepod inlet.

Halo.material: Grade 5 Titanium Ti-6Al-4V + 20 mm aero fairing

plank10mm.skidMaterial: Ti-6Al-4V Grade 5 Titanium (flush with plank bottom Z_FIA = -10 mm)

massBreakdownKg.fiaDriverReferenceBallastMarginNote: Includes 80 kg driver+seat+kit baseline (768 kg = FIA C4.1 724 kg race car+driver + 44 kg nominal 18-inch dry tyre set).

travelLimits.armClearanceAndRecessRule: All inboard wishbone/rod/tie-rod clevises extend 25 mm inside the survival-cell/gearbox fairings through teardrop boot apertures, and all outboard balljoint ends terminate 20 mm inside upright/drum shrouds on radial < 195 mm (< 219 mm 18-inch rim inner barrel radius), guaranteeing zero detachment or rim collision across [-35 mm, +45 mm] heave and +-19 deg road-wheel lock.

glbSceneGraph.compressionPipeline: Meshopt / gltfpack compatible (scripts/compress-car-glb.mjs); preserve named empties and animated node hierarchies.

rootMetadataExtras.description: Attach to scene/root custom properties in Blender so glTF extras populate root.userData in Three.js.

specialMaterials.INT_DISPLAY: Assigned exclusively to mfd_display quad mesh (0..1 UV unflipped) for live canvas telemetry texture binding.
specialMaterials.EXT_clearled_security: Assigned to ers_safety_lights meshes (rear FIA rain/ERS matrix + lateral status LEDs) for emissive wet/harvest pulsing.
specialMaterials.tyreMeshSuffix: _TYRE (e.g. wheel_fl_TYRE, wheel_fr_TYRE, wheel_rl_TYRE, wheel_rr_TYRE) for contact-patch bulge & lateral shear vertex shader.

chassis.role: 6-DOF sprung body root (monocoque, nose + twin-keel pylons + fixed fw_mainplane, crescent sidepods + dorsal canyons, floor + undercut + diffuser + 1-element triangular wheel-wake boards, engine cover + cooling gills, 20g roll hoop, titanium Halo, mirrors, twin-pylon RW endplates + rw_mainplane + lower crash brace).

plank.role: 10 mm permaglass plank (z in [-1.214, +1.406] m, Z_FIA in [-10, 0] mm) + 3 flush Ti-6Al-4V titanium skid blocks.

fw_flap_2.role: Front wing primary active flap (L+R outboard of fixed +-150 mm twin-keel nose saddle), 72% chord dual-link cambered slot-gap pivot.

fw_flap_3.role: Front wing secondary upper active flap (L+R outboard of nose saddle), 75% chord dual-link cambered slot-gap pivot.

rw_flap_2.role: Rear wing middle active flap, 72% chord dual-link endplate/pylon slot-gap pivot.

rw_flap_3.role: Rear wing upper active flap, 75% chord dual-link endplate slot-gap pivot.

ers_safety_lights.role: Rear crash-structure FIA rain/ERS safety LED cluster + lateral ERS safety status indicators.

steering_column.role: Fixed steering column carrier pitched -14 deg about +X so child steering_wheel local +Z points forward down column axis [0, -0.24192, +0.97030].

steering_wheel.rotationSignRule: rotation.z = +steering * (210 deg in rad), where steering in [-1..+1] (+1 = clockwise right turn).

corner_fl.role: Unsprung FL upright carrier (translates with heave/scrub, rotates with road-wheel steer about Y and camber about Z; does NOT spin).

caliper_fl.role: FL 6-piston brake caliper + internal cooling shroud (steers & cambers with corner_fl, stationary relative to spin).

wheel_fl.role: FL spinning 18-inch forged rim + 336 mm C/C brake rotor + narrowed 280/705-R18 Pirelli tyre.

caliper_fr.role: FR 6-piston brake caliper + internal cooling shroud.

wheel_fr.role: FR spinning 18-inch forged rim + 336 mm C/C brake rotor + narrowed 280/705-R18 Pirelli tyre.

corner_rl.role: Unsprung RL upright carrier (heave + camber + rear toe kinematics; does NOT spin).

caliper_rl.role: RL rear brake-by-wire caliper + cooling shroud.

wheel_rl.role: RL spinning 18-inch forged rim + 276 mm C/C brake rotor + narrowed 375/710-R18 Pirelli tyre.

caliper_rr.role: RR rear brake-by-wire caliper + cooling shroud.

wheel_rr.role: RR spinning 18-inch forged rim + 276 mm C/C brake rotor + narrowed 375/710-R18 Pirelli tyre.

suspensionLinks.pivotRule: Each wishbone/rod/link local origin sits at the midpoint of its inboard chassis pickups (rotates about inboard axis to track upright balljoint heave/steer) with 25 mm inboard & 20 mm outboard shroud overlap so zero gap ever appears.

ice.configuration: 1.6L (1600 cc) 90-deg V6 four-stroke, single exhaust turbocharger, NO MGU-H

ersK.speedDeratingStandardKw: 350 kW for v <= 290 kph; (1800 - 5*v_kph) for 290 < v < 340 kph; (6900 - 20*v_kph) for 340 <= v < 345 kph; 0 kW for v >= 345 kph (FIA C5.2.8)
ersK.speedDeratingOvertakeModeKw: 350 kW for v <= 337.5 kph; max(0, 7100 - 20*v_kph) up to 355 kph; 0 kW for v >= 355 kph (FIA C5.2.8)

blender-fia.gitNotes: Do NOT edit .gitignore (dirty in root workspace). Stage public/cars/lc26-f1/** explicitly with git add -f. Keep artifacts/renders/** local/untracked unless coordinator requests force-staging.

phase2_reservedIntegrationFiles.rule: STRICTLY RESERVED FOR PHASE 2 INTEGRATION — NO Phase 1 agent may edit or stage any of these files!

forbiddenDirtyWorkspaceFiles.rule: Pre-existing uncommitted changes in the workspace. NEVER edit, revert, or stage in any phase.
